invented.quote: The Long Dark Season: Keep the Light Burning
invented.why: The brief does not give the title or subtitle of the game.

invented.quote: The supply boat won't come again until spring. The oil has to last, the children have to eat, and ships need the light every night.
invented.why: The brief only says you see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter and does not mention a supply boat, oil, children, or nightly ships.

invented.quote: on an island at the edge of the map.
invented.why: The brief does not say the lighthouse is on an island or at the edge of the map.

invented.quote: Each turn you decide what gets done today and what has to wait: fixing the lamp, rationing the stores, caring for someone who's sick, or going out in the storm.
invented.why: The brief gives no details about turn structure or specific actions like fixing the lamp, rationing stores, caring for the sick, or going out in a storm.

invented.quote: No two winters play out the same, and the hardest choices often have nothing to do with the light.
invented.why: The brief does not mention replayability or the nature of the choices in the game.

invented.quote: Tested at hundreds of tables, one game at a time
invented.why: The brief says there were 140 playtest sessions, not hundreds of tables.

invented.quote: families, first-timers, longtime hobby gamers and solo players.
invented.why: The brief only says the game was playtested with about 60 different people, without describing who they were.
The brief does not state that changes were made after every playtest session.
The brief states the creator took the game to two conventions, but does not give the reason or say it was tested with strangers.

invented.quote: The rest: platform and payment fees, plus a reserve for freight and surprises
invented.why: While $17,400 for manufacturing and $13,500 for shipping 1,500 copies already exceed the $28,000 goal, the brief says nothing about platform fees, payment fees, or a reserve for freight and surprises.

invented.quote: It doesn't include any pay for me.
invented.why: The brief does not state whether the creator is taking any pay from the campaign funds.

invented.quote: If we go past the goal, the extra money gives the project a safety margin before any stretch goals.
invented.why: The brief does not mention stretch goals or how funds raised beyond the $28,000 goal will be used.

invented.quote: To lower that risk, I locked in the manufacturing quote before launch, budgeted shipping per copy, and built a reserve into the goal.
invented.why: The brief mentions having a factory quote and a shipping cost estimate, but does not say the quote is locked in or that a reserve was built into the $28,000 goal.

invented.quote: This game has been through four winters of playtesting.
invented.why: The brief only states that playtesting has been happening since 2023, without specifying how many winters that spans.
